overall_goal: Chop the broccoli, add the vegetables to the pan, and stir them

goals.description: Chop the broccoli into smaller pieces
goals.rationale: The person retrieves broccoli from the air fryer and chops it into smaller pieces on the cutting board.

goals.description: Continue chopping the broccoli into smaller pieces
goals.rationale: The person continues to grab more broccoli from the air fryer and chop it on the cutting board.

goals.description: Transfer the chopped broccoli and other vegetables to the pan
goals.rationale: The person moves the chopped broccoli from the cutting board and the remaining vegetables from the air fryer tray into the pan, then mixes them.

goals.description: Stir the vegetables in the pan
goals.rationale: The person mixes the vegetables and seasoning in the pan, handling a piece of food that fell out.

goals.description: Continue stirring the vegetables in the pan
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly shakes the pan and uses the spatula to mix the vegetables.

goals.description: Continue stirring the vegetables in the pan
goals.rationale: The person continues to mix the vegetables by shaking the pan and stirring with the spatula.

goals.description: Finish stirring the vegetables and turn off the stove
goals.rationale: The person gives the vegetables a final stir and turns off the stove.
